671-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-8250-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-8250-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Repeat.

141-3085-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3085-5231.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {R}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

640-678-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
640-678-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6798-7729--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6798-7729--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1368-4785-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4785-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2376-2921--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

4613-4774-5296-6713.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4613-4774-5296-6713.description:
Activate Workhorse using Pack Rat's ability by paying {3} and discarding a card, creating a token copy of it that will enter with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Workhorse token four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Workhorse token dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Shadow, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

1170-2054-2440-7577.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
1170-2054-2440-7577.description:
Cast the copy of Swords to Plowshares from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Emeritus of Truce.
When Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares enters, it and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Emeritus of Truce trigger, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Inkling creature token with flying and preparing Emeritus of Truce.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C} since Displacer Kitten and Emeritus of Truce are both Cats.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares, exiling a creature an opponent controls and causing them to gain life.
Activate Urn of Godfire by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat any number of times.
If the board state allows, create an Inkling token in step 4 instead of targeting an opponent.
1170-2054-2440-7577.notes: The exact results depend on the board state, but you should typically be able to reach a point where an opponent has more creatures than you and get the most beneficial combination of results.

997-2281-6909.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
997-2281-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

296-3446-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3446-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-2459-4053-6989.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Rograkh enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1414-4195-4574-6918.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3661-5220-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

2060-4222-6702--119.description:
Tap Kilo using any free method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

783-826-1399-1606.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Jungle Basin.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

2265-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Hardened Scales.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

969-1563-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

478-804-2821-3789-6071.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3789-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
478-804-2821-3789-6071.description:
Animate Candelabra using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and The Core.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

3277-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Izzet Chronarch each turn.
3277-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chronarch by paying its mana cost.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Izzet Chronarch from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1987-4125-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4125-4423-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV>=4 that has a generic mana cost

866-2921-5220--66.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone enough times to cast the creature with MV>=4  for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
866-2921-5220--66.description:
Cast the creature with MV>=4 for its blitz cost by paying {0}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2440-2816-5663.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token.
You control at least four creatures that share a creature type with the creature token.
Cayth does not have summoning sickness.
2440-2816-5663.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of a creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with it.
Activate Cayth by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2440-2816-5663.notes: You may begin the combo with less creatures that share a type with the token, but you will need additional mana to do so until you begin to break even from Mana Echoes' trigger. Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Cayth to get infinite proliferate.

1335-3334-4929.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-3334-4929.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once Cryptic Trilobite has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may remove them for infinite mana, then repeat step 1 to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, which can then be used for Marath's other modes.

1558-3263-3598.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness.
Rapacious One can not be blocked.
1558-3263-3598.description:
Attack with Rapacious One.
When Rapacious One deals combat damage, it triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by sacrificing five Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1061-1744-1953.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{U}{U} on your first turn, with {2}{U}{U} available on each extra turn
1061-1744-1953.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
1061-1744-1953.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.

813-1964-1987-2427.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
